# herdsman import

<!-- Generated by make docs. Change the source it names and regenerate. -->

Rebuild an account from an export.

```text
usage: herdsman import <export> [--state-dir <path>]

Rebuilds an account from an export into an empty state directory, which must
have no daemon running on it.

exit codes:
  0  imported
  1  refused or failed
  2  bad usage
```
